metaTitle: Techlio | AI Agents, n8n Automation and Software Development Company
metaDescription: Techlio builds production AI agents, n8n and AI automation, SaaS products and secure, governed AI systems for startups, enterprises and growing businesses in the US, UK and Europe. Book a free scoping call.
heroTitle: We build AI agents, automations and software *that run your business.*
heroIntro: Most AI pilots never reach production. Techlio builds AI agents, n8n and AI automations and SaaS products that do: tested against evals, secured and governed, and run by the senior engineers who scoped them.
servicesTitle: Plan it, build it, secure it, *run it*
servicesIntro: Four stages of getting AI into production, each available on its own. Start where you are.
offersPrompt: Prefer a fixed scope and a fixed date?
processIntro: Four phases, each ending in something you can hold us to.

process.title: Scope
process.text: A free 30-minute call with a senior engineer, followed by a focused discovery of your stack, workflows and goals.

process.title: Design
process.text: You get a proposal with scope, timeline and approach, and an architecture you can question, before any code is written.

process.title: Build
process.text: Weekly releases you can use. Every change passes tests, evals and security checks and is reviewed by a senior engineer.

process.title: Run
process.text: We monitor quality, cost and latency in production, improve from real usage, and hand over when your team is ready.

workIntro: AI systems and platforms we engineered for clients in biotech, media and sports tech.
bookingIntro: A senior engineer reads every request and replies within 24 hours with questions, a first read on approach, and times for a 30-minute scoping call.
bookingPoints: Mutual NDA before the call if you want one
You talk to an engineer, not a salesperson
You leave the call with a written scope outline
proofTitle: Results our clients can point to
proofIntro: Outcomes from platforms we built and still run with our clients.
